setup: Set the seat so the pads meet your chest or shoulders
Hook your feet under the rollers if there are any
Hold the handles lightly; your arms just hold on
execution: Breathe out and curl your ribs toward your hips
Round your upper back; keep your hips still
Squeeze for a moment at the bottom
Come back up slowly; keep the stack off its rest
faults: Don't pull the handles down with your arms
Don't hinge at the hips instead of curling
Don't let the stack crash between reps
Don't jerk the weight with momentum

notes: Machines differ: some have a chest pad, others arm pads or handles overhead. Read the machine's label and set the seat before you load it.
Return under control each rep so the stack never slams down.
Coaching sources differ on how much loaded crunching is wise. A common middle ground is moderate volume, built up gradually.
Stack numbers vary between machines and brands; compare only on the same machine.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Crunch
regressions.reason: Same curl with no added load; learn to curl the ribs down first.

progressions.name: Ab crunch machine with a pause
progressions.reason: A one-second squeeze in the curled position adds difficulty without more weight.

substitutions.name: Cable crunch
substitutions.reason: Same loaded curl kneeling at a cable column. Stack numbers aren't comparable.

substitutions.name: Decline crunch
substitutions.reason: Curl against gravity on a bench; add a plate to load it.

substitutions.name: Captain's chair knee raise
substitutions.reason: Trains the abs by curling the pelvis up instead; no stack needed.

substitutions.name: Ab-wheel rollout
substitutions.reason: Hard ab work that resists arching rather than curling.

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view at seated chest height. Draw the seat, back pad and chest pad simply, with no brand detail; the weight stack can be left out. The hips must stay visibly fixed on the seat.

keyPositions.label: Upright
keyPositions.describe: Seated tall, back against the pad, pads at the chest, hands resting on the handles, feet hooked under the rollers. Torso upright.

keyPositions.label: Curled
keyPositions.describe: Upper and middle back rounded forward, ribs pulled toward the hips, chin slightly tucked. Hips and thighs unchanged on the seat; the bend comes from the spine, not a hip hinge.

ikHints: Pelvis and thighs fixed to the seat in every frame
Chest stays in contact with the pads as they travel
emphasise: The upper back rounds; the hips stay put
Short squeeze in the curled position
doNotShow: Hinging forward from the hips with a flat back
